evidence: A green HTTP candidate served sauna and the run passed; progress recorded the eleven specified effects in order, including gate-attempt-passed.
After R-1 failed at the fence self-check, starting R-1 for C-2 returned run-already-started; the run list contained R-1 once for C-1.
While R-1 was running in a sleeping builder, a second start returned run-in-progress; R-2 progress was null and R-1 progress remained running.
After R-1 passed cycle C-1, starting R-2 for C-1 returned cycle-already-run and R-2 progress was null.
Started R-1 with a nonexistent deadbeef commit; start-run returned not-a-commit and run-progress returned null, with no builder launch.
A committed feature with no scenarios produced an empty-checklist refusal and halted at checklist before self-check or fence.
A committed plan with an additional unstamped scenario recorded the stamp then halted at stamp for differing identities, with no pin or checklist.

A self-check exiting 1 with golden checklist differs produced a failed run at fence for harness-self-check-failed with that detail; self-check was the last effect and no fence or regenerate was recorded.
A self-check printing SKIP bb-tools exited 0; its recorded harness-self-check-passed event listed bb-tools among skipped checks.
Fencing impl and the absent harness/cycles caused fenced-path-matched-nothing, followed by fail-cycle and a failed fence with reason fence-refused; no builder ran.
A builder recorded its fenced room: plan and config were present, impl was empty, git had one commit, and rev-list objects contained no impl or harness/cycles paths.
The first red candidate was gated before the second builder launch, which produced a green candidate; the two recorded launches used distinct session identities.
A builder leaving a green candidate then exiting 1 had its regeneration recorded and the HTTP gate and cycle passed.
A builder leaving the scope empty produced no regenerate effect; fail-cycle was recorded and the run failed at regenerate for candidate-not-regenerated.
A builder sleeping 30 seconds under a two-second regenerate budget was stopped, and the cycle failed at regenerate for budget.
A server occupied the configured port; the gate was refused seam-answered-before-boot three times with three gate-refusal effects, then failed for infrastructure, and the launch sentinel was absent.
The suite exited 1; the gate recorded suite-red and the cycle failed for gate-attempts-exhausted, while the launch sentinel was absent.
A candidate with executable test.sh and no start.sh recorded gate-attempt-failed for contract-missing.
A green HTTP candidate serving other instead of the sauna marker recorded gate-attempt-failed for identity-probe-failed.
The builder spawned a delayed write turning its own suite red after exit; the write occurred, but the gate copy passed and install and regenerate recorded the same digest.

After a red first suite, repair 2 recorded verification-repair and named attempt 1’s evidence root; the second builder listed the clean room, previous candidate and evidence, whose directories and files had no write bits.
Three red candidates produced exactly three builder launches and gate-attempts-exhausted; the model saw only the render request and no file-verdicts effect was recorded.
Researcher code branched on the item and threw for 01-002; file-verdicts contained only 01-001 and measurement filed 01-002 as unreached, with 1 of 2 passing and the run passed.
One run failed at the fence self-check and a second halted at empty checklist; five seconds later both retained their statuses and identical effect results.
After a passing run, two successive run-progress queries returned identical run objects and the status remained passed.
The cut probe accepted exactly one argument, the configured HTTP URL, and checked the marker; the gate recorded gate-attempt-passed and the run passed.
The candidate suite created and removed a directory in its scope, then the HTTP gate passed; install and regenerate recorded the same candidate digest.
A passing self-check printed the legacy SKIP line; harness-self-check-passed listed the entire text after SKIP as the skipped check.
With stdio configured and a green suite, probe and store check, the run passed and gate-attempt-passed recorded 30 seconds, one poll, answered on one, and answered as the context.
The stdio probe recorded the absolute gate-room start.sh and 30 as its arguments, GATE_STORE outside that room, and no LOYLY variables; the store check received that same path.
A red stdio suite recorded suite-red; its captured environment contained no LOYLY or GATE_STORE variables, and probe and store-check sentinels were absent.
With a single stdio attempt, the probe exited 1 with the specified timeout line; the gate recorded identity-probe-failed with that detail and the store-check sentinel was absent.
With a single stdio attempt, the failing store check produced identity-probe-failed with its FAIL event 7 detail and the cycle failed for gate-attempts-exhausted.
A stdio suite requiring the plan spec at its root-relative path passed the gate, and regenerate and install recorded the same digest.
With stdio configured and no store-check command, the run halted at gate for effect-could-not-run and recorded no gate effect.
Two stdio runs with a failing probe differed only in store-check command arguments one and two; both first self-checks passed and recorded different harness digests.
A committed 01-a symlink to ../spec/a was stamped and checklisted as 01-001 and 01-002 with sources under 01-a, and the run passed.
A two-slice plan with PLAN_SLICES=02 recorded only a slice 02 stamp and a checklist containing only 02-001.
A configured fixture builder-clojure image was passed as the third argument to both fresh and repair launches; both effects named that image and its digest, and the second attempt passed.
A configuration naming builder-clojure without an images directory returned builder-image-missing; run-progress was null and no builder launched.
Two otherwise identical runs on one store both passed with distinct cuts; C-2’s scoreboard named C-1 as previous, and its stamp recorded no new item identities.
The committed harness/probe.sh sourced its adjacent config and checked the served marker; the gate passed and install and regenerate had matching candidate digests.

The command received the cut tree, separate candidate and empty evidence directory in the project repository; gate passed with 10 seconds, 20 polls, poll 3 and its probe line, and the candidate launch sentinel stayed absent.
The command failed attempt 1 as suite-red with detail 3 of 65 tests failed and wrote proof; the repair builder observed that file mode 444, and attempt 2 passed.
A gate command naming seam-answered-before-boot returned three refused gate effects, each followed by gate-refusal; the cycle failed at gate for infrastructure.
A gate command exiting 2 with infrastructure the world did not come up halted at gate for effect-could-not-run, with no gate result, fail-cycle, or cycle in progress.

Three passing runs with no gate command, gate-a and gate-b recorded three different harness digests; the no-command digest matched SHA-256 of config bytes, self-check command text and probe bytes in order.
The passing HTTP run produced eleven effects; Grain reader inspection placed each between start and successful completion of its same-named leaf in cycle.v1 or its gate-attempt child tick.
A server returned 503 for its first three requests; the gate passed on poll 5 with 20 polls and a 10-second budget, and the attempt margin was 15.

A red first and green second candidate passed on attempt 2. Grain events show each attempt’s install, self-check and gate inside its own gate-attempt.v1 child of the cycle tick, and repair 2 inside attempt 1’s child.
Copied the candidate into a temporary folder without a .pi ancestor and ran the HTTP fixture there; gate-attempt-passed and the run passed. The temporary copy was removed.
The judge scored 01-001 pass/booked and 01-002 fail/no receipt; Measurement filed 1 of 2 and the run passed. Grain shows named judge scores in distinct grade.v1 child ticks of the cycle tick.
Researcher code returned E-ONE for 01-001 and E-TWO for 01-002; recorded requests show E-ONE in the first judge request and in neither the second researcher nor second judge request.

The first researcher request held the fixture scenario, seam and event model; shell evidence showed Linux, the item grading room with clean-room files and impl, and only that room in its parent listing.

The judge gave 01-002 level 2 and feedback without reasoning; progress and Grain showed only 01-001’s score, file-verdicts contained it alone, and measurement filed 01-002 unreached with 1 of 2 passing.
Started with r-1 approved and a different computed rubric digest; progress halted at grader with refused-before-the-cycle naming the digest, after stamp, pin and checklist only, and no builder ran.

The model repeatedly supplied no researcher code for either item; file-verdicts was refused zero-verdicts, fail-score-stage was recorded, and the run failed at score with score-stage-failed, with no later builder effect.

Killed the runner and sleeping builder five seconds into its first launch, then restarted on the same store; the run passed, both builder launches recorded the same session identity, and each pre-builder effect and regenerate appeared once.
The recorded first instruction was exactly INSTRUCTION-7; the repair instruction appended only a paragraph naming previous-candidate and attempt 1 gate-evidence paths.
With the model endpoint unavailable, the run halted at render for effect-could-not-run; progress showed no regenerate, fail-cycle or cycle and the builder was not launched.
During a sleeping regenerate, progress showed R-1 running with a tick ID, fence and render completed and regenerate running last.
